references.text: The same ritual for guilt offerings and oil applies to the poor who cannot afford three lambs.
The priest takes the guilt offering lamb and waves it as a wave offering before the Lord.
Guilt offering (אָשָׁם) as atonement for sin.
The laws concerning the guilt offering and its holy character.
Wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) before the Lord as part of the sacrificial rituals.
Wave offering performed by the priest before the Lord.
The Nazirite brings a one-year-old lamb as a guilt offering during the cleansing ritual.
Oil used in priestly consecration and holy rituals.
